desc:
Welcome to Ragdoll Labs - your own physics lab full of test dummies!

Every dummy reacts for real: they flinch, stumble, crawl, panic and go flying. Shoot them, launch them, crush them, run them over - and let the physics do the rest.

🧬 CLONE MACHINE - type ANY username and out walks a dummy wearing their avatar!

🧪 IN THE LAB
• Launch Cannon, Spike Wall, Wrecking Ball, Hydraulic Press
• Acid Pool, Mega Blender, Dummy Grinder, Bottomless Pit
• Stairs of Doom, Bounce Park, High Dive, Rocket Lab, Crash Test Track
• 50+ weapons - guns, bows, a golf club, a boomerang and more
• Vehicles - Go-Kart, Golf Cart, Dirt Bike
• Server events: Nuke, Tornado, Dummy Rain, Zero-G, Flash Freeze

🎮 Click: fire • B: weapons • N: spawn a dummy • T: slow-mo • G: time stop
📱 Fully playable on phone!

Daily rewards, weekly leaderboards and new stuff every update.
👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss the next one!
